title: An immersion has fibres of degree at most one (Stacks 03J9)
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be an immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] (a closed immersion followed by an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]). Then the integer $1$ bounds the degrees of the fibres of $j$ [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound]: for every $x\in X$ the fibre $Z_x=Z\times_X\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)$ is finite over $\kappa(x)$ with $\dim_{\kappa(x)}\Gamma(Z_x,\mathcal O_{Z_x})\le1$ (it is empty if $x\notin j(Z)$ and isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)$ over $\kappa(x)$ if $x\in j(Z)$). In particular the fibres of $j$ are universally bounded. (Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma Tag 03J9.)
